# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Responder's second call after a one-level suit opening, a one-level
# response and opener's rebid (Standard American). Rick's rulings: responder
# invites with 2NT or a jump in his own suit (6+); a new suit by responder
# after opener's 1NT is not forcing unless it is a responder's reverse (with
# New Minor Forcing on, 2 of the other minor is artificial instead:
# new-minor-forcing.bid). Ranges: weak 6-10, invitational 11-12, game 13+
# opposite a minimum rebid, in total points, which count length (a six-card
# suit adds two). See responder-rebids.notes.md.
#
# Every call here that says "play here" sets `ask=signoff`, and every
# invitation sets `ask=invite(suit)` or `ask=nt_invite`. Opener answers
# all three in rebids.bid, written against the question instead of
# against the auction that asked it (LANGUAGE.md §10).

module responder-rebids "Responder's second call"
  kind   system
  needs  rebids
  skill  partnership_bidding/responders_rebid
  skill  bidding_conventions/fourth_suit_forcing
  param  nmf = bidding_conventions/new_minor_forcing:after_1nt_rebid default false
  param  fsf = bidding_conventions/fourth_suit_forcing default false
  param  style = general.style
  param  inverted = bidding_conventions/inverted_minors default false
  # Artificial calls after opener's 1NT rebid (checkback.bid, roudi.bid,
  # two-way-nmf.bid) switch off the natural calls they take.
  param  checkback = bidding_conventions/checkback default false
  param  roudi = bidding_conventions/roudi default false
  param  twoway_sw = bidding_conventions/two_way_nmf default false
  param  xyz = bidding_conventions/xyz default false   # xyz.bid: two-way NMF after 1NT too
  param  imp2s = bidding_conventions/impossible_2s default false
  param  rkcb = bidding_conventions/roman_keycard default false

# ── Opener rebid 1NT (12-14, or above a weak notrump) ───────────────
# The counts are against opener's shown minimum (a three-point range),
# 25 between us for game:
# opposite 12-14 weak 10 or less, invitational 11-12, game 13+; opposite
# the weak-notrump card's 1NT, a good 14 to 17 (rebids.bid, Rick
# 2026-11-07), 8 or less, 9-10, 11+.
define nt_rebid_signoff = points + partner.hcp.min <= 22
define nt_rebid_invite = points + partner.hcp.min >= 23, points + partner.hcp.min <= 24
define nt_rebid_game = points + partner.hcp.min >= 25
define nt_rebid_no_game = points + partner.hcp.min <= 24
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 1N (P) when !tw(x)
  P   "Weak: no game"                      shows nt_rebid_signoff
      priority -5
  2y  "Weak: 6+ {y}"                       shows y>=6, nt_rebid_signoff   sets ask=signoff
      when  y is H | y is S                # a weak minor passes 1NT
  3y  "Invitational: 6+ {y}"        shows y>=6, nt_rebid_invite   sets ask=invite(y)
      when  !(twoway_sw | xyz)                        # two-way NMF: invitations start with 2C
  2N  "Invitational"              shows nt_rebid_invite, y<=5   sets ask=nt_invite
      when  !(twoway_sw | xyz)
  3N  "Game"                          shows nt_rebid_game, y<=5 | y is C | y is D
  2x  "Weak: 5+ {x}"                       shows x>=5, nt_rebid_signoff   sets ask=signoff
      when  x is H | x is S | (x is C, !checkback, !roudi, !(twoway_sw | xyz)) | (x is D, !(twoway_sw | xyz))
after 1x (P) 1M (P) 1N (P) when !tw(x)
  4M  "Game: 6+ {M}"                       shows M>=6, nt_rebid_game
after 1M (P) 1y (P) 1N (P)
  # The raise itself agrees opener's major (five facing three): trump is
  # set (Rick, 2026-10-03: "1H-1S-1NT-3H, where the bid itself makes the
  # agreement").
  3M  "Invitational: 3 {M}"  shows M=3, tp(M)+partner.hcp.min>=23, tp(M)+partner.hcp.min<=24   sets trump=M, ask=invite(M)
  # Opener's major is five: three cards make the fit, and a major fit plays
  # better than notrump (Rick, ticket b400, 2026-10-02). Support points,
  # as the support hand counts.
  4M  "Game in opener's major: 3+ {M}"  shows M>=3, tp(M)+partner.hcp.min>=25
      sets  trump=M
      priority 1

# New suits after 1NT: below responder's suit, natural and not forcing
# (5-4, weak); above it, a responder's reverse (game forcing).
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 1N (P) when !tw(C)
  2H  "Responder's reverse: 4+ hearts, 5+ diamonds, game forcing"  shows H>=4, D>=5, nt_rebid_game  sets forcing=game
  2S  "Responder's reverse: 4+ spades, 5+ diamonds, game forcing"  shows S>=4, D>=5, nt_rebid_game  sets forcing=game
after 1C (P) 1H (P) 1N (P) when !tw(C)
  2D  "4+ diamonds, 5+ hearts, not forcing"  shows D>=4, H>=5, nt_rebid_no_game   when !nmf, !(twoway_sw | xyz)   sets ask=signoff
  2S  "Responder's reverse: 4+ spades, 5+ hearts, game forcing"    shows S>=4, H>=5, nt_rebid_game  sets forcing=game
after 1C (P) 1S (P) 1N (P) when !tw(C)
  3H  "Four hearts, five spades, game forcing"  shows H>=4, S>=5, nt_rebid_game   sets forcing=game
  2D  "4+ diamonds, 5+ spades, not forcing"  shows D>=4, S>=5, nt_rebid_no_game   when !nmf, !(twoway_sw | xyz)   sets ask=signoff
  2H  "4+ hearts, 5+ spades, not forcing"   shows H>=4, S>=5, nt_rebid_no_game   sets ask=signoff
after 1D (P) 1H (P) 1N (P)
  2C  "4+ clubs, 5+ hearts, not forcing"   shows C>=4, H>=5, nt_rebid_no_game   when !nmf, !checkback, !roudi, !(twoway_sw | xyz)   sets ask=signoff
  2S  "Responder's reverse: 4+ spades, 5+ hearts, game forcing"    shows S>=4, H>=5, nt_rebid_game  sets forcing=game
after 1D (P) 1S (P) 1N (P)
  3H  "Four hearts, five spades, game forcing"  shows H>=4, S>=5, nt_rebid_game   sets forcing=game
  2C  "4+ clubs, 5+ spades, not forcing"   shows C>=4, S>=5, nt_rebid_no_game   when !nmf, !checkback, !roudi, !(twoway_sw | xyz)   sets ask=signoff
  2H  "4+ hearts, 5+ spades, not forcing"   shows H>=4, S>=5, nt_rebid_no_game   sets ask=signoff
after 1H (P) 1S (P) 1N (P)
  2C  "4+ clubs, 5+ spades, not forcing"   shows C>=4, S>=5, nt_rebid_no_game   when !checkback, !(twoway_sw | xyz)   sets ask=signoff
  2D  "4+ diamonds, 5+ spades, not forcing"  shows D>=4, S>=5, nt_rebid_no_game   when !(twoway_sw | xyz)   sets ask=signoff

# ── Opener rebid his suit (6+, minimum) ──────────────────────────────
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 2x (P) when !tw(x)
  P   "Weak: no game"                      shows points<=10
      priority -5
  2y  "Weak: 6+ {y}"                       shows y>=6, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
  3y  "Invitational: 6+ {y}, 11-12"        shows y>=6, points=11..12   sets ask=invite(y)
  3x  "Raise: 2+ {x}, 10-12"              shows x>=2, points=10..12   sets ask=invite(x)
  3x  "Raise: 3+ {x}, 7-9"  shows x>=3, points=7..9   sets ask=signoff
      when  style is bba, x is C | x is D  # BBA raises opener's six-card minor on 7
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12"                shows points=11..12, x<=1, y<=5  sets ask=nt_invite
  # Opposite six, two is a fit: a doubleton in opener's major bids 4M,
  # not 3NT (Rick, 2026-10-02), as the 2NT invitation above already
  # needs a singleton.
  3N  "Game: 13+"                          shows points>=13, x<=1 | x is C | x is D
after 1M (P) 1y (P) 2M (P)
  4M  "Game: 2+ {M}, 13+"                  shows M>=2, points>=13

# ── Opener raised responder's suit (4+, minimum) ─────────────────────
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 2y (P) when !tw(x)
  P   "Weak: no game"                      shows tp(y)<=10
      priority -5
  3y  "Invitational: 11-12"                shows tp(y)=11..12   sets ask=invite(y)
after 1x (P) 1M (P) 2M (P) when !tw(x)
  4M  "Game: 13+"                          shows tp(M)>=13
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 2D (P) when !tw(C)
  3N  "Game: 13+"                          shows points>=13

# ── Opener bid a new suit at the one level (not forcing) ─────────────
# The fourth suit at the one level stays natural whatever the card says
# about fourth suit forcing: 1♠ here is a real suit (rebids.bid answers it).
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 1H (P) when !tw(C)
  1S  "4+ spades"                          shows S>=4, H<=3
      priority 1
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 1z (P) when !tw(x)
  1N  "6-10, no fit"                       shows points<=10, z<=3   sets ask=signoff
  2x  "Preference: 3+ {x}, weak"           shows x>=3, points<=10, z<=3   sets ask=signoff
      when  !xyz                           # XYZ (xyz.bid): 2C and 2D are artificial
      priority -1
  2z  "Raise: 4+ {z}, weak"                shows z>=4, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
  3z  "Invitational raise: 4+ {z}, 11-12"  shows z>=4, points=11..12   sets ask=invite(z)
  2y  "Weak: 6+ {y}"                       shows y>=6, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
      when  !xyz | y is H | y is S         # XYZ: weak diamonds go through 2C
  3y  "Invitational: 6+ {y}, 11-12"        shows y>=6, points=11..12   sets ask=invite(y)
      when  !xyz                           # XYZ: invitations start with 2C
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12"                shows points=11..12, z<=3   sets ask=nt_invite
      when  !xyz                           # XYZ: 2NT relays to 3C
  3N  "Game: 13+"                          shows points>=13, z<=3
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 1M (P) when !tw(x)
  4M  "Game raise: 4+ {M}, 13+"            shows M>=4, points>=13
# Responder's 1♠ over 1♣-1♦-1♥ (above) is unlimited, and opener's
# minimum answers (rebids.bid, "Responder bid a fourth suit at the one
# level") set `ask=signoff`, which left a game-going responder only the
# pass (2026-09-30: with a card that bids majors up the line this auction
# is common). Game and invitations as after any minimum rebid.
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 1z (P) 1M (P) 1N (P) when !tw(x)
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12"                shows points=11..12   sets ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game: 13+"                          shows points>=13
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 1z (P) 1M (P) 2M (P) when !tw(x)
  3M  "Invitational: 11-12"                shows tp(M)=11..12   sets ask=invite(M)
  4M  "Game: 13+"                          shows tp(M)>=13
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 1z (P) 1M (P) 2x (P) when !tw(x)
  3N  "Game: 13+"                          shows points>=13

# The fourth suit at the two level: natural unless the card plays fourth
# suit forcing (`other_conventions.fourth_suit_forcing.play`, set by
# Bridge-Classroom's cards; the .bbsa keys set only one_round/game_force,
# so the corpus keeps it natural). There is no artificial 2♣ yet.
after 1D (P) 1H (P) 1S (P)
  2C  "5+ clubs, 8-10"                     shows C>=5, points=8..10, S<=3   sets ask=signoff
      when  !fsf_on, !xyz              # fourth-suit-forcing.bid; XYZ: 2C relays

# ── Opener bid a new suit at the two level (a reverse is forcing) ────
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 2z (P) when z is not x, z is not y, !tw(x)
  P   "Weak: to play"                   shows points<=10, z>=4 | z>x
      priority -5
  2x  "Preference: weak"                   shows x>=2, points<=10, x>=z | (z<=3, x is H) | (z<=3, x is S)   sets ask=signoff
  2y  "Weak: 6+ {y}"                       shows y>=6, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
  3z  "Invitational raise: 4+ {z}"         shows z>=4, points=11..12   sets ask=invite(z)
  3x  "Invitational: 3+ {x}"               shows x>=3, points=11..12   sets ask=invite(x)
  # After a reverse (17+, forcing) 2NT is the forced minimum, not an
  # invitation, and 11-12 opposite 17+ is game (2026-10-09: the forced
  # 2NT read as 11-12).
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12"                shows points=11..12, z<=3   sets ask=nt_invite
      when  !(we.forcing = round)
  3N  "Game: 13+"                          shows points>=13, z<=3 | z is C | z is D
  3N  "Game: 11+"     shows points>=11, z<=3 | z is C | z is D
      when  we.forcing = round
  2N  "Minimum, no fit"     shows points<=10
      when  we.forcing = round             # after a reverse
      priority -4
# With game values and three of opener's five-card major: 4M, not 3NT
# (Rick, ticket b400, 2026-10-02: 1H-1S-2C, AKQ5.Q832.T84.Q7 bid 3NT with
# a nine-card heart fit; BBA plays 4H).
after 1M (P) 1y (P) 2z (P) when z is not M, z is not y
  4M  "Game in opener's major: 3+ {M}, 13+ support points"  shows M>=3, tp(M)>=13
      sets  trump=M
      priority 1

# ── Opener's jump rebid (6+, 16-18) or jump raise (4+, 16-18) ───────
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 3x (P) when !tw(x)
  P   "Weak: no game"                      shows points<=8
      priority -5
  3N  "Game: 9+"                           shows points>=9, x<=1 | x is C | x is D
after 1M (P) 1y (P) 3M (P)
  4M  "Game: 2+ {M}, 8+"                   shows M>=2, points>=8
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 3y (P) when !tw(x)
  P   "Weak: no game"                      shows points<=8
      priority -5
  3N  "Game: 8+"                           shows points>=8
      when  y is not H, y is not S         # with a major fit, 4M
after 1x (P) 1M (P) 3M (P) when !tw(x)
  4M  "Game: 9+"                           shows points>=9
# After a minor's jump rebid (2026-10-20, Brill daily board 7: 1D 1S 3D
# 4D, and opener had no rule for the raise). Standard practice, not yet
# cited; Brill /explain reads the 4m raise as "D >= 3, HCP 7-9". The
# raise invites five of the minor with three-card support and 8 points
# (7 passes, as BBA on the Basic-Bridge corpus: responder-rebids.test; 9+
# bids 3NT above, or the major); five of a responder's major goes back
# to opener as 3M, forcing, so that a 5-3 fit is found before 3NT; six
# or more bids the game in it.
after 1m (P) 1y (P) 3m (P) when !tw(m)
  4{m} "Invitational raise: 3+ {m}, 8"   shows m>=3, points=8
after 1m (P) 1M (P) 3m (P) when !tw(m)
  3{M} "Five {M}, forcing: choose 3NT or 4{M}"   shows M=5, points>=9
      sets  forcing=round
  4{M} "Game: six or more {M}, 9+"          shows M>=6, points>=9

# ── Opener's 2NT (18-19) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 2N (P) when !tw(x)
  P   "Weak: no game"                      shows points<=6
      priority -5
  3N  "Game: 7+"                           shows points>=7, y<=5 | y is C | y is D, hcp + partner.hcp.min <= 31   # with more, the catch-all below looks at slam
after 1x (P) 1M (P) 2N (P) when !tw(x)
  4M  "Game: 6+ {M}"                       shows M>=6, points>=7
after 1M (P) 1y (P) 2N (P)
  4M  "Game in opener's major: 3+ {M}"     shows M>=3, tp(M)>=7
      priority 1                           # a major fit before 3NT (ticket b400)

# ── After responder's 1NT and opener's rebid ─────────────────────────
after 1x (P) 1N (P) 2z (P) when z is not x
  P   "To play in {z}"   shows z>=4 | z>x
      priority -5
  3m  "To play: six or more {m}"   shows m>=6, x<=1, z<=2
      when  m is not x, m is not z
      sets  ask=signoff
  2x  "Preference: 2+ {x}"                 shows x>=2, x>=z | (z<=3, x is H) | (z<=3, x is S)   sets ask=signoff
      when  shown.x.max<=2 | x is C | x is D
  # The 6-12 1NT over a major (2/1 cards) may hold a weak three-card
  # raise (5-7 support points: responses.bid), and the preference then
  # shows it (Rick, 2026-11-06, bridge-classroom-bug-artifacts #87: "2S
  # or 3S with 5-7 support pts"; 2026-11-07: support points, not HCP).
  2x  "Preference: two {x}, or three with a weak raise (5-7 support points)"
      shows (x=2, z<=3, hcp<=10) | (x=3, tp(x)<=7)
      when  x is H | x is S, shown.x.max>=3
      sets  ask=signoff
  # A three-card raise worth more (8+ support points) raises at once
  # (responses.bid), so this hand bid 1NT off our book, as Rick's
  # board-14 hand did. It still prefers the major; partner reads the
  # rule above.
  2x  "Preference: three {x}"
      shows x=3, hcp<=10
      when  x is H | x is S, shown.x.max>=3
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -3
  3z  "Raise: 4+ {z}, 9-10"               shows z>=4, points=9..10   sets ask=invite(z)
  # The good raise (11+ points) is the Impossible 2♠ after 1♥ when the
  # card plays it (impossible-2s.bid); otherwise it raises too (it passed).
  3z  "Raise: 4+ {z}, 11+ points"          shows z>=4, points>=11   sets ask=invite(z)
      when  z is C | z is D, x is not H | !imp2s
# Six hearts too weak for 2H at once, opposite 1S and a minor: to play
# (2026-09-30, random deals: J.AT75432.6.QJ53 had no call; BBA 2H).
after 1S (P) 1N (P) 2m (P)
  2H  "To play: six or more hearts"   shows H>=6, S<=1, hcp<=10
      sets  ask=signoff
# After the 6-12 1NT of the 2/1 cards (2026-09-30, 2/1 game force): the
# 11-12 hands invite, and three-card support is a limit raise.
after 1M (P) 1N (P) 2z (P) when z is not M, shown.hcp.max >= 11, !(we.forcing = round)   # a reverse: below
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12, no fit"        shows hcp=11..12, M<=2, z<=3   sets ask=nt_invite
  3M  "Limit raise: three-card support, 10-12"   shows M=3, tp(M)=10..12   sets ask=invite(M)
      priority 1
  3z  "Raise: 4+ {z}, 11-12 HCP"           shows z>=4, hcp=11..12   sets ask=invite(z)   # the new band only: 9-10 with length is impossible-2s.bid's
      when  z is C | z is D
after 1M (P) 1N (P) 2M (P) when shown.hcp.max >= 11
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12"                shows hcp=11..12, M<=2   sets ask=nt_invite
  3M  "Invitational: two or three {M}, 11-12"   shows M>=2, hcp=11..12   sets ask=invite(M)
      priority 1
# The pass is in HCP: the 1NT response is 6-10 HCP, and with length
# points a 1NT responder can count 11-12 and had no call. BBA raises
# with a doubleton from 8 HCP (probes/resp-1H-1N-2H, 2026-09-25: 60 of
# 79 hands with 8-10 and two hearts); an eight-card fit opposite six.
after 1x (P) 1N (P) 2x (P)
  P   "No game"                            shows hcp<=10
      priority -5
  3x  "Raise: 3+ {x}, invitational"
      shows x>=3, points>=10   sets ask=invite(x)
      when  x is C | x is D                # 1M-1NT denied three: partner read 3M as this, with no fit
  3x  "Invitational raise: 2+ {x}, 8-10"
      shows x>=2, hcp>=8   sets ask=invite(x)
      when  x is H | x is S                # over a minor, 3m rarely reaches game
      when  shown.hcp.max <= 10            # a 6-12 1NT (2/1) invites with 11-12 above
      priority -1
after 1x (P) 1N (P) 3x (P)
  P   "No game"                            shows points<=8
      priority -5
  3N  "Game, no fit"                       shows points>=9, x<=1 | x is C | x is D
after 1M (P) 1N (P) 3M (P)
  4M  "Game: 2+ {M}, 8+"                   shows M>=2, points>=8
after 1x (P) 1N (P) 2N (P)
  P   "No game"                            shows points<=6
      priority -5
  3N  "Game: 7+"                           shows points>=7

# ── After a two-over-one and opener's rebid ──────────────────────────
# A 2/1 is 11+ suit points opposite an opening, so the pair is close to
# game: with support for opener's major, bid it; without a major fit,
# 2NT invites and 3NT is game. Opener's suit may be a minor (1♦-2♣-2♥),
# and then notrump is the only game to look for, so the rules that do
# not name a major are written for any opening suit `y`.
#
# The 2/1 itself is measured in suit points (a 5-4-3-1 ten-count bids
# it), so the calls that choose a suit are measured the same way, and
# only the notrump bids count notrump points.
#
# "No fit" in the game bids counts opener's length as he showed it
# (Rick, 2026-10-16). Outside a 2/1 game force his 2M is six or more; in
# one it follows the card's rebid style (rebids.bid,
# `major_openings.two_over_one.rebid_style`): Bergen (the default) 2M
# six and 2NT the five-card default; Lawrence 2M five or more and 2NT
# balanced; Schuler 2M exactly five and 2NT six or more. Two cards
# opposite six is the fit and plays 4M (the rules after this block, and
# fit.bid over opener's 2NT); two opposite five is not, and bids 3NT.
after 1y (P) 2x (P) 2z (P) when x is not y, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, y))
  2N  "Invitational, no fit: 11-12"        shows points=11..12, y<=2 | y is C | y is D
      when  !we.gf
      sets  ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game, no fit"                       shows points>=13, y+partner.y.min<=7 | y is C | y is D
      when  !we.gf
  # In a game force (2/1 cards) the notrump rebids are two ranges (Rick,
  # 2026-11-06, bridge-classroom-bug-artifacts #91): 2NT is 12-14 or
  # 18-19 (more is slam at once, or 2NT too), forcing, so opener goes on
  # describing and counts slam opposite the minimum; the jump to 3NT is
  # 15-17 balanced, and opener counts slam on it with over-3nt.bid. It
  # replaced 3NT 13-15 / 2NT 16+ in notrump points (2026-09-30); the
  # ranges are HCP now, as notrump ranges are, so that over-3nt.bid's
  # HCP count reads them. Four cards in opener's second major raise it
  # instead (below).
  3N  "Game, no fit: 15-17"  shows hcp=15..17, y+partner.y.min<=7 | y is C | y is D
      when  we.gf
  2N  "Game forcing, no fit: 12-14 or 18+"
      shows hcp<=14 | hcp>=18, y+partner.y.min<=7 | y is C | y is D, z<=3 | z is C | z is D
      when  we.gf
  3x  "Invitational: 6+ {x}, 11-12"        shows x>=6, suit_points=11..12, y<=2 | y is C | y is D
      when  !we.gf
      sets  ask=invite(x)
  2y  "Preference: 2+ {y}"
      shows y>=2, suit_points<=12
      when  !we.gf
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -3                          # a ten-count with shape: no game bid fits
  P   "Minimum: no game"
      shows suit_points<=12
      priority -5                          # opener rebid his own suit: nowhere to go
  # A game-forcing two-over-one (2/1 cards, 2026-09-30): no invitations
  # and no sign-off; a preference or the long suit again keeps it going.
  3x  "Six or more {x}, game forcing"      shows x>=6
      when  we.gf
      priority -1
  2y  "Preference: 2+ {y}, game forcing"   shows y>=2
      when  we.gf
      priority -3
# Fast arrival (2026-09-30, slam entry, slam-entry.notes.md): the jump to
# game is the minimum; with slam interest agree the suit below game and
# force, so control bids and the keycard ask can follow. Random deals:
# responder jumped to game here with 19 HCP and 33 between the hands.
after 1M (P) 2x (P) 2z (P) when x is not M, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, M))
  4M  "Game with support: no slam interest"  shows tp(M)=11..15, M>=3 | (M>=2, partner.M>=6)
  3M  "Support for {M}, slam interest: forcing"  shows tp(M)>=16, M>=3 | (M>=2, partner.M>=6)
      sets  trump=M, forcing=game
# Opener's second suit, a major: raise it (there was no raise at all).
after 1y (P) 2x (P) 2z (P) when x is not y, z is not y, z is H | z is S, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, y))
  4z  "Raise: 4+ {z}, no slam interest"    shows z>=4, points=11..14
  3z  "Raise: 4+ {z}, slam interest, forcing"  shows z>=4, points>=15
      sets  trump=z, forcing=game
after 1y (P) 2x (P) 3x (P) when x is not y, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, y))
  4x  "Game in the fit"                    shows suit_points>=11
      when  x is H | x is S                # spades: 1H 2S, a strong jump shift (ticket b173)
      priority 1                           # responder's own major fit first
  3N  "Game"                               shows points>=12, y<=2 | y is C | y is D
      when  x is H | x is S | ((x is C | y is C | stop(C) | partner.cued(C) | partner.C.min>=4 | shown.C.min>=4), (x is D | y is D | stop(D) | partner.cued(D) | partner.D.min>=4 | shown.D.min>=4), (x is H | y is H | stop(H) | partner.cued(H) | partner.H.min>=4 | shown.H.min>=4), (x is S | y is S | stop(S) | partner.cued(S) | partner.S.min>=4 | shown.S.min>=4))
  P   "Minimum: no game"       shows suit_points<=12
      priority -5
# A minor fit (Rick, 2026-09-25): no control bids with a minor agreed.
# New suits below 3NT show stoppers, up the line, looking for 3NT with 5m
# as the backup; a suit skipped is denied (`sets ladder=stopper` keeps
# the record). A suit is covered by my stopper, one partner has shown, or
# a suit either of us bid naturally.
after 1y (P) 2x (P) 3x (P) when x is C | x is D, x is not y, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, y))
  cheapest(C)  "Stopper in ♣, looking for 3NT"
      when  x is not C, y is not C, cheapest_rank(C) < 19
      when  points>=12, stop(C), !((x is C | y is C | stop(C) | partner.cued(C) | partner.C.min>=4 | shown.C.min>=4), (x is D | y is D | stop(D) | partner.cued(D) | partner.D.min>=4 | shown.D.min>=4), (x is H | y is H | stop(H) | partner.cued(H) | partner.H.min>=4 | shown.H.min>=4), (x is S | y is S | stop(S) | partner.cued(S) | partner.S.min>=4 | shown.S.min>=4))
      sets  ask=stoppers, ladder=stopper, trump=x, forcing=game
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(C)
      priority 1
  cheapest(D)  "Stopper in ♦, looking for 3NT"
      when  x is not D, y is not D, cheapest_rank(D) < 19
      when  points>=12, stop(D), !((x is C | y is C | stop(C) | partner.cued(C) | partner.C.min>=4 | shown.C.min>=4), (x is D | y is D | stop(D) | partner.cued(D) | partner.D.min>=4 | shown.D.min>=4), (x is H | y is H | stop(H) | partner.cued(H) | partner.H.min>=4 | shown.H.min>=4), (x is S | y is S | stop(S) | partner.cued(S) | partner.S.min>=4 | shown.S.min>=4))
      sets  ask=stoppers, ladder=stopper, trump=x, forcing=game
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(D)
      priority 1
  cheapest(H)  "Stopper in ♥, looking for 3NT"
      when  x is not H, y is not H, cheapest_rank(H) < 19
      when  points>=12, stop(H), !((x is C | y is C | stop(C) | partner.cued(C) | partner.C.min>=4 | shown.C.min>=4), (x is D | y is D | stop(D) | partner.cued(D) | partner.D.min>=4 | shown.D.min>=4), (x is H | y is H | stop(H) | partner.cued(H) | partner.H.min>=4 | shown.H.min>=4), (x is S | y is S | stop(S) | partner.cued(S) | partner.S.min>=4 | shown.S.min>=4))
      sets  ask=stoppers, ladder=stopper, trump=x, forcing=game
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(H)
      priority 1
  cheapest(S)  "Stopper in ♠, looking for 3NT"
      when  x is not S, y is not S, cheapest_rank(S) < 19
      when  points>=12, stop(S), !((x is C | y is C | stop(C) | partner.cued(C) | partner.C.min>=4 | shown.C.min>=4), (x is D | y is D | stop(D) | partner.cued(D) | partner.D.min>=4 | shown.D.min>=4), (x is H | y is H | stop(H) | partner.cued(H) | partner.H.min>=4 | shown.H.min>=4), (x is S | y is S | stop(S) | partner.cued(S) | partner.S.min>=4 | shown.S.min>=4))
      sets  ask=stoppers, ladder=stopper, trump=x, forcing=game
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(S)
      priority 1
  cheapest(y)  "No stopper to show below 3NT"
      when  cheapest_rank(y) < 19
      when  points>=12, !((x is C | y is C | stop(C) | partner.cued(C) | partner.C.min>=4 | shown.C.min>=4), (x is D | y is D | stop(D) | partner.cued(D) | partner.D.min>=4 | shown.D.min>=4), (x is H | y is H | stop(H) | partner.cued(H) | partner.H.min>=4 | shown.H.min>=4), (x is S | y is S | stop(S) | partner.cued(S) | partner.S.min>=4 | shown.S.min>=4))
      sets  ask=stoppers, ladder=stopper, trump=x, forcing=game
      priority -2
  5x  "Game in the minor: a suit unstopped"
      shows points>=12
      when  !((x is C | y is C | stop(C) | partner.cued(C) | partner.C.min>=4 | shown.C.min>=4), (x is D | y is D | stop(D) | partner.cued(D) | partner.D.min>=4 | shown.D.min>=4), (x is H | y is H | stop(H) | partner.cued(H) | partner.H.min>=4 | shown.H.min>=4), (x is S | y is S | stop(S) | partner.cued(S) | partner.S.min>=4 | shown.S.min>=4))
      priority -3

after 1M (P) 2x (P) 3x (P) when x is not M, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, M))
  4M  "Game with support"                  shows tp(M)>=11, M>=3
after 1y (P) 2x (P) 3z (P) when x is not y, z is not y, z is not x, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, y))
  3N  "Game, no fit"                       shows points>=10, y<=2 | y is C | y is D
# Opener's new suit at the three level: 3M agrees and is forcing with
# 13 or more, 4M is the minimum (BBA: 3S 13+ total points, 4S 11-12,
# probes/slam-1S-2D-3C-resp.toml; we had no 3M, 2026-10-01). Opener
# then counts for slam with the suit agreed.
after 1M (P) 2x (P) 3z (P) when x is not M, z is not M, z is not x, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, M))
  3M  "Support, 13+: forcing, room for slam"  shows points>=13, M>=3   sets trump=M, forcing=game
  4M  "Game with support: a minimum"       shows tp(M)>=11, points<=12, M>=3
  3x  "Six or more {x}: forcing"           shows x>=6, M<=2   sets forcing=game
      when  cheapest_rank(x) < 19            # still at the three level
# Opener's 2NT or jump rebid over a two-over-one: the 2/1 was 11+, so
# game is there. The 2NT is 15-17 balanced where the 2/1 forces one
# round; in a game force it is the style's (above): with a major fit
# fit.bid plays 4M or agrees it below game first, and otherwise 3NT.
after 1y (P) 2x (P) 2N (P) when x is not y, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, y))
  3N  "Game: 11+"     shows points>=11
  P   "Minimum: no game"    priority -5
# With a weak notrump 1D-2C-2NT is 12-14 or 18+ (rebids.bid; Rick,
# 2026-11-07), the mirror of responder's game-forcing 2NT (#91): count
# slam on its minimum, as opener does there; opener's strong branch
# invites over the 3NT.
after 1D (P) 2C (P) 2N (P) when partner.hcp.min <= 14, partner.hcp.max >= 18
  6N  "Slam in notrump"
      shows points + partner.hcp.min >= 33
      priority 1
  4N  "Quantitative: invites 6NT"
      when  quant_4nt   # slam.quantitative_4nt.play (slam-entry.bid)
      shows points + partner.hcp.min >= 31
      sets  ask=quant
      priority 1
after 1y (P) 2x (P) 3y (P) when x is not y, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, y))
  3N  "Game, no fit"                       shows points>=11, y<=1 | y is C | y is D
                                           # the jump rebid is six: two is a fit
  P   "Minimum: no game"    priority -5

# After 2NT (12-14 or 18+) and opener's 3NT (no extras: rebids.bid),
# the strong branch invites (Rick, 2026-11-06, #91): 18-20 quantitative,
# answered by one-nt.bid's `when asked quant`; 21+ bids the slam. The
# minimum passes.
after 1y (P) 2x (P) 2z (P) 2N (P) 3N (P) when x is not y, we.gf, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, y))
  4N  "Quantitative: 18-20, invites 6NT"   shows hcp=18..20
      when  quant_4nt   # slam.quantitative_4nt.play (slam-entry.bid)
      sets  ask=quant
      priority 1
  6N  "Slam: 21+"                          shows hcp>=21
      priority 1

after 1M (P) 3M (P) 3N (P)
  4M  "Prefers the major: four trumps"     shows M>=4

# ── After opener's invitation over a raise ───────────────────────────
after 1M (P) 2M (P) 3M (P)
  4M  "Accepts: top of the raise"          shows tp(M)>=9
      when  style is not bba
  P   "Declines"                           shows tp(M)<=8
      when  style is not bba
  # BBA accepts with 10 HCP, or four trumps and a singleton; a flat 9
  # usually declines.
  4M  "Accepts: 10 HCP, or four trumps and a singleton"
      shows hcp>=10 | (M>=4, shortest<=1)
      when  style is bba
  P   "Declines"
      when  style is bba
      priority -5

# ── After a two-over-one and opener's jump rebid (6+, 16-18) ─────────
after 1M (P) 2x (P) 3M (P) when x is not M, !(wjs_on, two_level_jump(x, M))
  4M  "Game"                               shows points>=11

# ── Opener reversed ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# A reverse is 17+ and forcing for one round, so responder always bids
# again: game with a maximum, a raise with four of the second suit, and
# otherwise a preference back to opener's first suit. `we.forcing = round`
# is what tells a reverse from an ordinary second suit below the first,
# which responder may pass.
after 1x (P) 1N (P) 2y (P) when y is not x, we.forcing = round
  3N  "Game: a maximum for the 1NT response"
      shows hcp>=9
  3{y} "Raise: four or more {y}"
      shows y>=4
  3{x} "Preference to {x}"
      shows x>=2
      priority -1

# ══ Responder's second call once they have come in ═══════════════════
#
# Opener's contested rebids (rebids.bid) mostly set `ask=signoff` or
# `ask=invite`, and the state blocks answer those wherever they came
# from. What is left is opener's free calls — his answer to a negative
# double, his rebids after a redouble, and the auctions where he has
# passed and left the decision here.

# ── We doubled for takeout and opener answered ───────────────────────
# The double showed 6+ and four cards in each unbid major, so opener's
# answer is limited and responder is usually done: BBA passes 16 of the
# 24 positions in the Basic-Bridge scenarios, with 6-10. `z` is
# opener's answer, which may be a repeat of his own suit.
after 1x (*) X (*) 1z (*) | 1x (*) X (*) 2z (*) | 1x (*) X (*) 3z (*) when they.bid
  P   "Minimum: no further bid"
      shows hcp+length_points<=10
      priority -5
  # The fit is eight cards between us, counted from what opener showed:
  # four with his four-card major, two with his own major rebid, which is
  # six or more (Rick, 2026-10-16, Brill daily board 8: 1S (3H) X (P) 3S
  # on 93.875.AK42.AKQ8 bid 3NT with no heart stopper; 4S is par).
  cheapest(z) "Raise: an eight-card fit in {z}, 11-12"
      shows z>=8-partner.z.min, hcp+length_points=11..12
      when  partner.z>=3          # opener's answer may be a three-card major
      sets  trump=z, ask=invite(z)
  4{z} "Game in {z}: 13+ with an eight-card fit"
      shows z>=8-partner.z.min, hcp+length_points>=13
      when  partner.z>=3, z is H | z is S
      sets  trump=z
  # Opener jumped (16-18 support points): game with 8+ (2026-09-25; we
  # stopped in 2M/3M on hands that reached game uncontested).
  4{z} "Game in {z}: 8+, an eight-card fit"
      shows z>=8-partner.z.min, hcp+length_points>=8
      when  partner.z>=3, z is H | z is S, partner.jumped
      sets  trump=z
      priority 1
  # Notrump needs their suit stopped (Rick, 2026-10-16, same board): no
  # stopper and no fit is the cue bid below or a pass.
  cheapest(N) "Invitational: 11-12 balanced, their suit stopped"
      shows balanced, hcp+length_points=11..12, stop(they.strain)
      when  they.strain is not none, they.strain is not N
      sets  ask=nt_invite
      priority -1                 # the fit first
  cheapest(N) "Invitational: 11-12 balanced"
      shows balanced, hcp+length_points=11..12
      when  they.strain is none | they.strain is N
      sets  ask=nt_invite
      priority -1                 # the fit first
  3N  "Game: 13+ balanced, their suit stopped"   # was jump(N): 4NT over a three-level answer
      shows balanced, hcp+length_points>=13, stop(they.strain)
      when  they.strain is not none, they.strain is not N
      priority -1
  3N  "Game: 13+ balanced"
      shows balanced, hcp+length_points>=13
      when  they.strain is none | they.strain is N
      priority -1
  # Game values, no fit and not balanced, their suit stopped: 3NT
  # (over a three-level overcall too, where the cue bid below is not
  # played).
  3N  "Game: 13+, no fit, their suit stopped"
      shows hcp+length_points>=13, z<=7-partner.z.min, stop(they.strain)
      when  they.strain is not none, they.strain is not N
      priority -2
  P   "No further bid"  priority -10

# Game values that are not balanced (2026-09-25: A762.T9.6.AKQ863 passed
# opener's minimum answer). 3NT with their suit held, else a cue bid of
# their suit, forcing to game. Over one- and two-level overcalls only.
after 1x (1y) X (P) 1z (P) | 1x (1y) X (P) 2z (P) | 1x (1y) X (P) 3z (P) | 1x (2y) X (P) 2z (P) | 1x (2y) X (P) 3z (P) when y is not x, y is not z
  3N  "Game: 13+, a stopper in {y}"
      shows hcp+length_points>=13, stop(y)
      when  partner.z<=3 | z is C | z is D
      priority -2
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 13+, no stopper in {y}, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp+length_points>=13
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -3

# ── We redoubled and they ran ────────────────────────────────────────
# The redouble was 10+, so the partnership owns the hand. Opener has
# passed it back: responder doubles with four **good** cards in their
# suit, supports opener with three, and otherwise lets it go.
#
# Rick, 2026-09-23: four small is not a penalty double. The holding has
# to be worth about two natural trump tricks on its own -- two of the
# top three honours, or three of the top five behind the bidder.
after 1x (X) XX (1y) P (P) | 1x (X) XX (2y) P (P) | 1x (X) XX (3y) P (P) when y is not x
  X   "Penalty: four good {y} behind the bidder"
      shows y>=4
      when  quality(y)>=good | top5(y)>=3
  cheapest(x) "Back to partner's suit: three or more, 10-11"
      shows x>=3, hcp<=11
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -1
  # Game values (2026-09-26: 12-13 counts went back to 2x and opener
  # passed with 14-16).
  3N  "Game: 12+ with a stopper in {y}"
      shows hcp>=12, stop(y)
  4{x} "Game: 12+ with three-card support"
      shows x>=3, hcp>=12
      when  x is H | x is S
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 12+, no stopper, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=12
      when  !stop(y), cheapest_rank(y) <= 18
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -1
  cheapest(S) "Five or more spades"
      shows S>=5
      when  x is not S, y is not S
      priority -2
  cheapest(H) "Five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, S<=4
      when  x is not H, y is not H
      priority -2
  P   "No further bid"  priority -10

# ── Opener reopened with a double ────────────────────────────────────
# Opener's reopening double (rebids.bid) is takeout, so responder names
# his longest suit at the cheapest level, passes it for penalty with
# four of theirs, or goes back to opener's suit. Four poor cards of
# theirs (not two of the top three or three of the top five) need 8 HCP
# as well: with 7 or fewer, 43 of 58 one-level passes let them make it
# (penalty-doubles.notes.md, 2026-10-02).
after 1x (1y) P (P) X (P) | 1x (2y) P (P) X (P) | 1x (3y) P (P) X (P) when y is not x
  P   "Passes the reopening double: four or more {y}"
      shows y>=4, y>=5 | quality(y)>=good | top5(y)>=3 | hcp>=8
      priority 1
  cheapest(S) "Four or more spades for the reopening double"
      shows S>=4, S>=H, S>=D, S>=C
      when  x is not S, y is not S
  cheapest(H) "Four or more hearts for the reopening double"
      shows H>=4, H>S, H>=D, H>=C
      when  x is not H, y is not H
  cheapest(D) "Four or more diamonds for the reopening double"
      shows D>=4, D>S, D>H, D>=C
      when  x is not D, y is not D
  cheapest(C) "Four or more clubs for the reopening double"
      shows C>=4, C>S, C>H, C>D
      when  x is not C, y is not C
  cheapest(x) "Back to partner's suit"
      shows x>=3
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -2
  cheapest(N) "Balanced with a stopper in {y}"
      shows balanced
      when  stop(y)
      priority -3
  P   "Passes the double"  priority -10

# ── Both sides have stopped ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Responder passed the overcall and opener passed again: nobody has
# anything, and BBA passes every one of these (6 of 6 with 3-9 points).
after 1x (*) P (*) P (P) when they.bid
  P   "No further bid"
      priority -10

# ── Opener rebid a new suit over their call ──────────────────────────
# The mirror of the uncontested blocks above, for the auctions where
# they have come in: opener's second suit at the one level leaves room
# for everything, and at the two level it may be a reverse, which our
# own rules make forcing — 58 of the corpus's broken forces were
# responder with no answer to one.
after 1x (*) 1y (*) 1z (*) when they.bid, y is not x, z is not x, z is not y
  cheapest(N) "6-10, no fit"                shows points<=10, z<=3   sets ask=signoff
  cheapest(x) "Preference: three or more {x}, weak"
      shows x>=3, points<=10, z<=3   sets ask=signoff
      priority -1
  cheapest(z) "Raise: four or more {z}, weak"   shows z>=4, points<=10   sets trump=z, ask=signoff
  jump(z) "Invitational raise: four or more {z}, 11-12"
      shows z>=4, points=11..12   sets trump=z, ask=invite(z)
  cheapest(y) "Weak: six or more {y}"       shows y>=6, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
  jump(y) "Invitational: six or more {y}, 11-12"  shows y>=6, points=11..12   sets ask=invite(y)
  jump(N) "Game: 13+"                       shows points>=13, z<=3
      when  nt_jump_to_game                  # 3NT at most (rebids.bid)
  4{z} "Game raise: four or more {z}, 13+"  shows z>=4, points>=13
      when  z is H | z is S
      sets  trump=z
  P   "No further bid"  priority -10
after 1x (*) 1y (*) 2z (*) when they.bid, y is not x, z is not x, z is not y
  cheapest(x) "Preference: two or more {x}"
      shows x>=2, points<=12
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -1
  cheapest(z) "Raise: four or more {z}"     shows z>=4, points>=10   sets trump=z, ask=invite(z)
  cheapest(y) "Weak: six or more {y}"       shows y>=6, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
  cheapest(N) "No fit"       shows points<=12
      priority -4
  jump(N) "Game: 13+"                       shows points>=13, z<=3
      when  nt_jump_to_game                  # 3NT at most (rebids.bid)
  P   "Weak: to play"          shows points<=10
      priority -5
  P   "No further bid"  priority -10

# ── They competed and both partners have nothing more ────────────────
# We made a free bid, they bid again, and opener passed it out to us.
# With a minimum we let it go; with a sixth card in our suit we compete.
after 1x (*) 1z (*) P (P) | 1x (*) 2z (*) P (P) when they.bid, z is not x
  cheapest(z) "Competes: six or more {z}"
      shows z>=6, points>=8
      sets  ask=signoff
  cheapest(x) "Competes: three or more {x}"
      shows x>=3, points>=10
      when  partner.x>=5
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -2
  P   "No further bid"  priority -10

# ── Opener answered the negative double in notrump ───────────────────
# The notrump answer is 12-14 with a stopper (18-19 for the jump), so
# responder treats it as the 1NT rebid: pass, raise by strength, or show
# a six-card suit.
after 1x (*) X (*) 1N (*) | 1x (*) X (*) 2N (*) when they.bid, partner.hcp.min <= 13 | partner.hcp.max <= 16 | partner.jumped
  P   "Minimum: no game"
      shows points<=10
      when  !partner.jumped
      priority -5
  # Opposite the jump (18-19), game from six.
  P   "Minimum: no game"
      shows points<=5
      when  partner.jumped
      priority -5
  3N  "Game"
      shows points>=6
      when  partner.jumped
  cheapest(S) "Weak: six or more spades"    shows S>=6, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
  cheapest(H) "Weak: six or more hearts"    shows H>=6, S<=5, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
  cheapest(N) "Invitational: 11-12"         shows points=11..12   sets ask=nt_invite
      when  partner.last=1N                 # over 2NT it is 3NT, the game below
  3N      "Game: 13+"                       shows points>=13   # was jump(N): 4NT over the 2NT answer
      when  !partner.jumped
  P   "No further bid"  priority -10

# Above a weak notrump the 1NT answer is 15-17 (after-interference.bid):
# the same calls, counted against his range.
after 1x (*) X (*) 1N (*) when they.bid, partner.hcp.min >= 14, partner.hcp.max >= 17
  P   "Minimum: no game"                   shows nt_rebid_signoff
      priority -5
  cheapest(S) "Weak: six or more spades"    shows S>=6, nt_rebid_signoff   sets ask=signoff
  cheapest(H) "Weak: six or more hearts"    shows H>=6, S<=5, nt_rebid_signoff   sets ask=signoff
  cheapest(N) "Invitational"      shows nt_rebid_invite   sets ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game"                                shows nt_rebid_game
  P   "No further bid"  priority -10

# ── Our double was left to them ──────────────────────────────────────
# They bid over the negative double and opener passed it out. He has a
# minimum with nothing to say, so responder needs real values to bid on.
after 1x (*) X (*) P (P) when they.bid
  cheapest(S) "Competes: five or more spades, 11+"
      shows S>=5, points>=11
      sets  ask=signoff
  cheapest(H) "Competes: five or more hearts, 11+"
      shows H>=5, S<=4, points>=11
      sets  ask=signoff
  cheapest(x) "Preference to partner's suit with 11-12"
      shows x>=3, points=11..12
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -2
  P   "No further bid"  priority -10
# With game values bid it (2026-09-26: 4m with 12-15 opposite a 13-14
# opener that passed: 97 corpus boards with 25+ HCP and game on). Only
# where 3NT is still available.
after 1x (1y) X (1y) P (P) | 1x (1y) X (2y) P (P) | 1x (1y) X (3y) P (P) | 1x (2y) X (3y) P (P) when y is not x
  3N  "Game: 13+ with a stopper in {y}"     shows points>=13, stop(y)
  4{x} "Game in partner's major: 13+ with three"   shows x>=3, points>=13
      when  x is H | x is S
  5{x} "Game in partner's minor: 13+ with three"   shows x>=3, points>=13
      when  x is C | x is D
      priority -1

# Opener after 1m-1S-1NT-3H (5-4 in the majors, game forcing): the fit.
after 1C (P) 1S (P) 1N (P) 3H (P) | 1D (P) 1S (P) 1N (P) 3H (P)
  4H  "Four hearts"                 shows H>=4
  4S  "Three spades"                shows S=3, H<=3
  3N  "Neither fit"                 shows S<=2, H<=3

# Answering a stopper bid with a minor agreed: 3NT with every suit
# covered; else the next stopper up the line below 3NT; else five of the
# minor. A suit partner denied that I cannot stop either is the reason
# for 5m.
when asked stoppers, (trump is C | trump is D)
  3N  "Every suit stopped: 3NT"
      when  (trump is C | stop(C) | partner.cued(C) | me.cued(C) | partner.C.min>=4 | shown.C.min>=4), (trump is D | stop(D) | partner.cued(D) | me.cued(D) | partner.D.min>=4 | shown.D.min>=4), (trump is H | stop(H) | partner.cued(H) | me.cued(H) | partner.H.min>=4 | shown.H.min>=4), (trump is S | stop(S) | partner.cued(S) | me.cued(S) | partner.S.min>=4 | shown.S.min>=4)
      priority 1
  cheapest(C)  "Stopper in ♣, looking for 3NT"
      when  trump is not C, cheapest_rank(C) < 19, stop(C), !partner.cued(C), !me.cued(C), !(partner.C.min>=4), !(shown.C.min>=4)
      sets  ask=stoppers, ladder=stopper
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(C)
  cheapest(D)  "Stopper in ♦, looking for 3NT"
      when  trump is not D, cheapest_rank(D) < 19, stop(D), !partner.cued(D), !me.cued(D), !(partner.D.min>=4), !(shown.D.min>=4)
      sets  ask=stoppers, ladder=stopper
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(D)
  cheapest(H)  "Stopper in ♥, looking for 3NT"
      when  trump is not H, cheapest_rank(H) < 19, stop(H), !partner.cued(H), !me.cued(H), !(partner.H.min>=4), !(shown.H.min>=4)
      sets  ask=stoppers, ladder=stopper
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(H)
  cheapest(S)  "Stopper in ♠, looking for 3NT"
      when  trump is not S, cheapest_rank(S) < 19, stop(S), !partner.cued(S), !me.cued(S), !(partner.S.min>=4), !(shown.S.min>=4)
      sets  ask=stoppers, ladder=stopper
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(S)
  5{trump}  "A suit unstopped: game in the minor"
      priority -3

# ── Opener's invitational raise of a minor (1m-2m-3m, 17-18) ────────
after 1m (P) 2m (P) 3m (P) when !inverted
  3N  "Accepts: the top of the raise"      shows hcp>=9
  P   "Declines: 6-8"                      shows hcp<=8
      priority -5

# ── Opener reopened with notrump (18-19 balanced, their suit stopped) ─
# Responder passed their overcall, and had no rule over the reopening
# (2026-09-25: 9-10 counts with no stopper passed out 1NT that reaches
# 3NT uncontested). Game from 7.
after 1x (1y) P (P) 1N (P) | 1x (2y) P (P) 2N (P) when y is not x
  3N  "Game: 7+"            shows hcp>=7
  P   "No game"                            shows hcp<=6
      priority -5

# ── Opener's notrump after I passed and they reopened (18-19) ────────
# My pass of the opening showed 0-5, so game is out of reach: pass, or
# with a six-card suit and a 1NT to escape from, play two of it.
# Natural, no Stayman or transfers: opener's notrump is a rebid, not an
# opening (Rick 2026-11-06, bridge-classroom-bug-artifacts #90).
after 1x (P) P (1y) 1N (P) | 1x (P) P (2y) 2N (P) when y is not x
  P   "No game"                            priority -5
  2S  "To play: six or more spades"        shows S>=6
      when  y is not S, partner.last=1N
      sets  ask=signoff
  2H  "To play: six or more hearts"        shows H>=6
      when  y is not H, partner.last=1N
      sets  ask=signoff
  2D  "To play: six or more diamonds"      shows D>=6
      when  y is not D, partner.last=1N
      sets  ask=signoff
  2C  "To play: six or more clubs"         shows C>=6
      when  y is not C, partner.last=1N
      sets  ask=signoff

# ── Opener's jump to 2NT over their overcall (17-18) ─────────────────
# 1D P 1H (2S) 2NT (P), 1C P 1H (1S) 2NT (P): my one-level response
# showed 6+, so the ladder is the uncontested one after 1x-1y-2NT: game
# from 7, five of my major offers a choice of games, six bids the game
# (bridge-classroom-bug-artifacts #93; 2NT is 17-18 since Rick's
# 2026-11-07 ruling, and BBA raises from 7-8, probes/opnt-r-*-2N.toml).
after 1x (P) 1z (2y) 2N (P) | 1x (P) 1z (1y) 2N (P) when y is not x, y is not z, z is not x
  P   "Weak: no game"                      shows points<=6
      priority -5
  3N  "Game: 7+"                           shows points>=7, z<=4 | z is C | z is D
  3{z} "Five {z}, forcing: choose 3NT or 4{z}"   shows z=5, points>=7
      when  z is H | z is S
      sets  forcing=round
  4{z} "Game: six or more {z}"             shows z>=6, points>=7
      when  z is H | z is S

# ── Opener's double after 1C P 1D (overcall): the other major ───────
# 1C P 1D (1S) X (P): opener has three or four hearts and 14-18
# balanced (15-18 over a two-level overcall; over 1H three spades).
# BBA (probes/opnt-r-1C-1D-1S-X.toml, opnt-r-1C-1D-2H-X.toml): the
# major with four, 2NT 8-9 and 3NT 10+ with their suit held, the cue
# bid 10+ without, otherwise diamonds with five or back to clubs.
when asked minor_x(M, x, y), rho.last=P, partner.last=X
  cheapest(M) "Four or more {M}, up to 11"     shows M>=4, hcp<=11
      sets  ask=signoff
  3N  "Game: 10+ with a stopper in {y}"        shows hcp>=10, stop(y), M<=3
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 10+, no stopper in {y}, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=10
      sets  forcing=game, ask=minor_x_cue(M, y)
      priority -1
  2N  "Invitational: 8-9 with a stopper in {y}"
      shows hcp=8..9, stop(y), M<=3
      sets  ask=nt_invite
  cheapest(D) "Five or more diamonds, up to 9" shows D>=5, hcp<=9
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -1
  cheapest(x) "Back to {x}"
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -5
# They raised over the double: compete with four of the major or five
# diamonds, bid game in notrump with 10+ and their suit held, else pass.
when asked minor_x(M, x, y), rho.last!=P, partner.last=X
  cheapest(M) "Four or more {M}, competing"    shows M>=4, hcp<=11
      when  cheapest_rank(M)<=18             # the three level at most (4H over 3S on 7 HCP, 2026-11-07)
      sets  ask=signoff
  3N  "Game: 10+ with a stopper in {y}"        shows hcp>=10, stop(y)
  cheapest(D) "Five or more diamonds, competing"  shows D>=5, hcp<=9
      when  cheapest_rank(D)<=14
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -1
  P   "Nothing more to say"
      priority -10
# Opener answered my cue bid in the major: no stopper in
# their suit. Game in the major with four, else 3NT.
when answered minor_x_cue(M, y), partner.last=2{M} | partner.last=3{M}
  4M  "Four {M}: game in the fit"          shows M>=4
      priority 1
  3N  "No fit: 3NT"

# Opener cue-bid their suit over my weak answer to his double: 17-18
# balanced, no stopper (rebids.bid). Notrump with their suit held, 3NT
# from 7; the major with four; five diamonds; else back to clubs.
when asked x_cue(y)
  3N  "Game: 7+ with a stopper in {y}"     shows hcp>=7, stop(y)
      priority 1
  2N  "A stopper in {y}, a minimum"        shows hcp<=6, stop(y)
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  cheapest(S) "Four spades"                shows S>=4
      when  y is H
      sets  ask=signoff
  cheapest(H) "Four hearts"                shows H>=4
      when  y is S
      sets  ask=signoff
  cheapest(D) "Five or more diamonds"      shows D>=5
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -1
  cheapest(C) "No stopper: clubs"
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -3

# ── Opener's strong new suit over their overcall (forcing to game) ───
# 1C P 1D (2H) 2S, 1C P 1D (1S) 2H, 1D P 1S (2C) 2H: a reverse, 19+;
# 1C P 1H (1S) 3D, 1C P 1S (2H) 3D, 1D P 1H (1S) 3C: 18+ (rebids.bid,
# Rick 2026-11-07: "5: yes"). BBA (probes/opns-r-1C-1D-2H-2S.toml,
# -1C-1D-1S-2H, -1D-1S-2C-2H, -1C-1S-2H-3D): a major raised to game
# with a minimum, one level with more; 3NT with their suit held; the
# minor's preference (BBA's 4m "try", 3m); my own suit with five or
# six; else the cue bid. BBA's 4NT keycard asks are not taken.
when asked rev(w, m, y, z)
  jump(w) "Four {w}, a minimum"              shows w>=4, hcp<=7
      when  w is H | w is S
      sets  trump=w
      priority 1
  cheapest(w) "Four {w}, 8+"                 shows w>=4, hcp>=8
      when  w is H | w is S
      sets  trump=w
      priority 1
  cheapest(w) "Four or more {w}"             shows w>=4
      when  w is C | w is D
      sets  trump=w
  3N  "A stopper in {y}"                     shows stop(y), w<=3, hcp<=11
      priority 1
  # Slam (Rick 2026-11-07: "5: yes"): the keycard ask with a fit and 32
  # between us on opener's floor; BBA asks with 15+ (4NT "0314").
  4N  "Keycard ask in {w}"
      when  rkcb, w is H | w is S
      shows w>=4, hcp + partner.points.min >= 32
      sets  trump=w, ask=keycards(w)
      artificial
      priority 3
  4N  "Keycard ask in {m}"
      when  rkcb
      shows m>=3, hcp + partner.points.min >= 32
      sets  trump=m, ask=keycards(m)
      artificial
      priority 2
  cheapest(z) "Six or more {z}"              shows z>=6
      when  z is H | z is S
  cheapest(z) "Five or more {z}"             shows z>=5, w<=3
      when  z is C | z is D
      priority -1
  # The minor: at the three level 3m is a minimum and 4m (BBA's "try")
  # shows 7+ with slam interest; with no room below game 4m is the
  # preference. All forcing: the strong new suit forced to game (Rick
  # 2026-11-07: "for our default, let's make it forcing").
  cheapest(m) "Three or more {m}, a minimum"   shows m>=3, hcp<=6
      when  cheapest_rank(m)<=18
      sets  trump=m
      priority 0   # the fit before my own minor
  4{m} "Three or more {m}, 7+: slam interest, forcing"   shows m>=3, hcp>=7
      when  cheapest_rank(m)<=18
      sets  trump=m
      priority 0   # the fit before my own minor
  cheapest(m) "Three or more {m}, forcing"     shows m>=3
      when  cheapest_rank(m)>=20
      sets  trump=m
      priority -1
  cheapest(y) "No stopper in {y}, no fit"
      alert  artificial
      priority -4

# Opener's uncontested jump shift after a minor opening (19+, forcing to
# game; `ask=js(w, m, z)`, rebids.bid). The same answers as over the
# strong new suit in competition, so the two read alike (Rick
# 2026-11-07: responder's 4m "for our default, let's make it forcing";
# with Minorwood on the card 4m is the ask once a minor is agreed, and
# minorwood.bid answers for itself). Before this the generic block for
# a two-level new suit read 1C-1D-2S-3C as invitational and 4C had no
# rule.
when asked js(w, m, z)
  4N  "Keycard ask in {w}"
      when  rkcb, w is H | w is S
      shows w>=4, hcp + partner.points.min >= 32
      sets  trump=w, ask=keycards(w)
      artificial
      priority 3
  4N  "Keycard ask in {m}"
      when  rkcb
      shows m>=4, hcp + partner.points.min >= 32   # opener's minor may be three cards
      sets  trump=m, ask=keycards(m)
      artificial
      priority 3
  jump(w) "Four {w}, a minimum"              shows w>=4, hcp<=7
      when  w is H | w is S
      sets  trump=w
      priority 2
  cheapest(w) "Four {w}, 8+"                 shows w>=4, hcp>=8
      when  w is H | w is S
      sets  trump=w
      priority 2
  cheapest(w) "Four or more {w}"             shows w>=4
      when  w is C | w is D
      sets  trump=w
      priority 1
  cheapest(m) "Three or more {m}, a minimum"   shows m>=3, hcp<=6
      when  cheapest_rank(m)<=18
      sets  trump=m
      priority 1
  4{m} "Three or more {m}, 7+: slam interest, forcing"   shows m>=3, hcp>=7
      when  cheapest_rank(m)<=18
      sets  trump=m
      priority 1
  cheapest(m) "Three or more {m}, forcing"     shows m>=3
      when  cheapest_rank(m)>=20
      sets  trump=m
      priority 1
  cheapest(z) "Six or more {z}"              shows z>=6
      when  z is H | z is S
      priority 1
  cheapest(z) "Five or more {z}"             shows z>=5, w<=3, m<=2
      when  z is C | z is D
      priority 1
  3N  "No fit"                               shows w<=3, hcp<=11, m<=2 | balanced
      when  cheapest_rank(N)<=19
      priority 2                              # balanced: 3NT before the minor (compare 2026-11-07)
  cheapest(N) "No fit, nothing more to say"
      priority -4

# 1D P 1M (2y) 3C (P): four or more clubs, five diamonds, 13-19, not
# forcing (BBA, probes/opns-r-1D-1H-2S-3C.toml, -1D-1S-2H-3C): pass
# with nothing, 3D with three diamonds to 10, 3NT 11+ with their suit
# held, three of my major with six, the cue bid 12+ without a stopper,
# game in a minor with a fit and 12+ (BBA's 4C / 4D invitations with
# 10-11 not taken).
after 1D (P) 1z (2y) 3C (P) when z is H | z is S, y is not z, y is not C, y is not D
  3N  "Game: 11+ with a stopper in {y}"    shows hcp>=11, stop(y), z<=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(z) "Six or more {z}, 9+"        shows z>=6, hcp>=9
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  3D  "Preference: three or more diamonds, up to 10"   shows D>=3, hcp<=10
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 12+, no stopper in {y}, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=12
      sets  forcing=game, ask=ns_cue(y)
      priority 1
  P   "No fit, no game"                     shows hcp<=10
      priority 1

# They competed over the 3C (compare 2026-11-07: GIB_1N5422 13, no
# rule): raise clubs with four, 3NT with game values and a stopper,
# else pass.
after 1D (P) 1z (2y) 3C (*) when z is H | z is S, y is not z, y is not C, y is not D, rho.last!=P
  4C  "Four or more clubs, competing"      shows C>=4, hcp<=10
      priority 1
  3N  "Game: 11+ with a stopper in {y}"    shows hcp>=11, stop(y)
      priority 1
  P   "Nothing more to say"
      priority -5

# 1D P 1H (1S) 2C (P): five-five in the minors, 13-17 (rebids.bid, Rick
# 2026-11-07: "6: yes"). BBA (probes/opns-r-1D-1H-1S-2C.toml): 2D or
# 3C, whichever minor is longer, 6-9; 2H with six hearts; 2NT 10-11 and
# 3NT 12+ with spades held; 3D 10-11 with three diamonds, inviting; the
# cue bid 2S with 12+ and no stopper. BBA's 4NT keycard ask not taken.
after 1D (P) 1H (1S) 2C (P)
  2D  "Preference: diamonds, up to 9"      shows D>=C, hcp<=9
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  3C  "Three or more clubs, up to 9"       shows C>D, C>=3, hcp<=9
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  2H  "Six or more hearts, up to 10"       shows H>=6, hcp<=10
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  2N  "Invitational: 10-11 with a spade stopper"   shows hcp=10..11, stop(S)
      sets  ask=nt_invite
      priority 1
  3N  "Game: 12+ with a spade stopper"     shows hcp>=12, stop(S)
      priority 1
  3D  "Invitational: three or more diamonds, 10-11"   shows D>=3, hcp=10..11
      priority 1
  2S  "Cue bid: 12+, no spade stopper, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=12
      sets  forcing=game, ask=ns_cue(S)
      priority 1
  2D  "No better bid: diamonds"
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -3

# ── Opener's natural spades after 1C P 1D (1H) ───────────────────────
# 1C P 1D (1H) 1S (P): four spades, 11-15 (rebids.bid). BBA (Rick
# 2026-11-07: "yes to 1 and 2"; probes/opns-r-1C-1D-1H-1S.toml), in HCP
# as BBA's ranges fall: the raise with four spades up to 9, 3S 10-11,
# 4S 12+; 1NT up to 10, 2NT 11-12 and 3NT 13+ with hearts held (BBA
# bids 1NT without a stopper too: not taken, Rick 2026-10-16); 2C with
# three clubs, 3C 11-12 with four, 2D / 3D with six diamonds, the cue
# bid with 13+ and no stopper. Priority 1: ahead of the generic block
# for opener's new suit over their call, which has no stopper.
after 1C (P) 1D (1H) 1S (P)
  2S  "Raise: four spades, up to 9"        shows S>=4, hcp<=9
      sets  trump=S, ask=signoff
      priority 1
  3S  "Invitational raise: four spades, 10-11"   shows S>=4, hcp=10..11
      sets  trump=S, ask=invite(S)
      priority 1
  4S  "Game: four spades, 12+"             shows S>=4, hcp>=12
      sets  trump=S
      priority 1
  1N  "Up to 10 with a heart stopper"      shows hcp<=10, stop(H), S<=3
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12 with a heart stopper"   shows hcp=11..12, stop(H), S<=3
      sets  ask=nt_invite
      priority 1
  3N  "Game: 13+ with a heart stopper"     shows hcp>=13, stop(H), S<=3
      priority 1
  2D  "Six or more diamonds, up to 10"     shows D>=6, hcp<=10, S<=3
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  3D  "Invitational: six or more diamonds, 11-12"   shows D>=6, hcp=11..12, S<=3
      sets  ask=invite(D)
      priority 1
  3C  "Invitational: four or more clubs, 11-12"     shows C>=4, hcp=11..12, S<=3
      sets  ask=invite(C)
      priority 1
  2C  "Preference: three or more clubs, up to 12"   shows C>=3, hcp<=12, S<=3
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  2H  "Cue bid: 13+, no heart stopper, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=13, S<=3
      sets  forcing=game, ask=ns_cue(H)
      priority 1
  2D  "Five diamonds, no better bid"       shows D>=5, hcp<=12
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  P   "Nothing to add"                     shows hcp<=10
      priority -5

# They competed over opener's 1S (1C P 1D (1H) 1S (2H)): the generic
# block for a new suit over their call bid its cheapest notrump, 3NT
# over 3H on 9 points (compare 2026-11-07, 1m-1N 186). Raise with four
# spades, 3NT with game values and hearts held, six diamonds compete at
# the three level, otherwise pass.
after 1C (P) 1D (1H) 1S (*) when rho.last!=P
  2S  "Four spades, competing"             shows S>=4, hcp<=9
      sets  trump=S, ask=signoff
      priority 1
  3S  "Invitational raise: four spades, 10-12"   shows S>=4, hcp=10..12
      when  rho.last<=2H
      sets  trump=S, ask=invite(S)
      priority 1
  3S  "Four spades, competing"             shows S>=4, hcp<=12
      when  rho.last>2H
      sets  trump=S, ask=signoff
      priority 1
  4S  "Game: four spades, 13+"             shows S>=4, hcp>=13
      sets  trump=S
      priority 1
  3N  "Game: 13+ with a heart stopper"     shows hcp>=13, stop(H), S<=3
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Six or more diamonds, competing"  shows D>=6, hcp>=7, S<=3
      when  cheapest_rank(D)<=16             # 3D at most
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority 1
  P   "Nothing more to say"                shows hcp<=12
      priority 1
  P   "No fit, no stopper"
      priority -5

# 1C P 1D (1H) 2S (P): four spades, 16+, forcing one round (rebids.bid).
# BBA (probes/opns-r-1C-1D-1H-2S.toml): 4S with four spades from 6-8
# (we count support points, game from 8), 3S below; 3NT 9+ with
# hearts held; the cue bid 3H 10+ without; 3D six diamonds up to 9; otherwise 3C back to clubs. BBA's 4C (11+, a club
# fit, slam interest) is not built: we bid 3NT or the cue bid.
after 1C (P) 1D (1H) 2S (P)
  4S  "Game: four spades, 8+ support points"   shows S>=4, tp(S)>=8
      sets  trump=S
      priority 1
  3S  "Four spades, a minimum"             shows S>=4, tp(S)<=7
      sets  trump=S, ask=invite(S)
      priority 1
  3N  "Game: 9+ with a heart stopper"      shows hcp>=9, stop(H), S<=3
      priority 1
  3D  "Six or more diamonds, up to 9"      shows D>=6, hcp<=9, S<=3
      sets  ask=invite(D)
      priority 1
  3H  "Cue bid: 10+, no heart stopper, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=10, S<=3
      sets  forcing=game, ask=ns_cue(H)
      priority 1
  3C  "Back to clubs: up to 9"             shows hcp<=9, S<=3
      priority 1
# Opener answered my cue bid without a stopper: game in clubs with a
# fit, else 3NT with something in hearts, else the best game we have.
when answered ns_cue(y), partner.last!=3N
  5C  "Game in clubs: three or more"       shows C>=3
      when  partner.last=3C | partner.last=4C
      priority 1
  3N  "A partial stopper in {y}: 3NT"      shows y>=3
  5D  "Game in diamonds"                   shows D>=5
      when  partner.last=3D | partner.last=4D
      priority 1
  4S  "Game in spades: three or more"      shows S>=3
      priority -1
  5C  "Game in clubs"
      priority -3

# ── Opener's values double of their two-level overcall (15-18) ───────
# 1D P 1H (2S) X (P): opener has 15-18 balanced with at most three of my
# major and of their suit (rebids.bid). BBA (probes/opnt-r-1D-1H-2S-X,
# opnt-r-1C-1H-2S-X): pass with four of their suit, a five-card major
# at the three level with 6-9, a minor with four, 2NT 8-9 and 3NT 10+
# with their suit held, a cue bid with 10+ and no stopper.
when asked values(M, x, y), rho.last=P, partner.last=X
  P   "Penalty: four or more {y}, up to 9" shows y>=4, hcp<=9
      priority 1
  4M  "Game: six or more {M}, 10+"         shows M>=6, hcp>=10
      sets  trump=M
  3N  "Game: 10+ with a stopper in {y}"    shows hcp>=10, stop(y), M<=4
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 10+, no stopper in {y}, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=10
      sets  forcing=game, ask=values_cue(M, x, y)
      priority -1
  2N  "Invitational: 8-9 with a stopper in {y}"
      shows hcp=8..9, stop(y), M<=4
      sets  ask=nt_invite
  cheapest(M) "Five or more {M}, 6-9"      shows M>=5, hcp<=9
      sets  ask=signoff
  cheapest(x) "Four or more {x}, up to 9"  shows x>=4, hcp<=9
      when  x is C | x is D
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -1
  cheapest(C) "Four or more clubs, up to 9"     shows C>=4, hcp<=9
      when  x is not C, y is not C
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -1
  cheapest(D) "Four or more diamonds, up to 9"  shows D>=4, hcp<=9
      when  x is not D, y is not D
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -1
  cheapest(x) "No better bid: back to {x}"
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -5

# ── One-level response in a contested auction, opener's minimum rebid ─
# Opener's contested minimum rebids ask for a sign-off, and responder
# passed them whatever he held, where uncontested he invites with 11-12
# and bids game with 13+ (2026-09-25: e.g. 1C (1D) 1H 2C, with 12
# opposite 17). These outrank the sign-off pass. Notrump needs their
# suit stopped; without it a cue bid forces to game.
after 1x (1z) 1y (P) 2x (P) when z is not x, z is not y, y is not x
  3x  "Invitational: 3+ {x}, 11-12"        shows x>=3, points=11..12
      sets  ask=invite(x)
  4x  "Game: 3+ {x}, 13+"                  shows x>=3, points>=13
      when  x is H | x is S
  3y  "Invitational: 6+ {y}, 11-12"        shows y>=6, points=11..12
      sets  ask=invite(y)
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12, {z} stopped"   shows points=11..12, stop(z), x<=2
      sets  ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game: 13+, {z} stopped"             shows points>=13, stop(z), x<=2 | x is C | x is D
  cheapest(z) "Cue bid: 13+, no stopper in {z}, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows points>=13
      when  cheapest_rank(z) <= 18      # below 3NT
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -2
after 1x (1z) 1y (P) 2y (P) when z is not x, z is not y, y is not x
  3y  "Invitational: 11-12 with the fit"   shows tp(y)=11..12
      sets  ask=invite(y)
  4y  "Game: 13+ with the fit"             shows tp(y)>=13
      when  y is H | y is S
  3N  "Game: 13+, {z} stopped"             shows points>=13, stop(z)
      when  y is C | y is D
after 1x (1z) 1y (P) 1N (P) | 1x (P) 1y (1z) 1N (P) when z is not x, z is not y, y is not x, partner.hcp.min <= 13 | partner.hcp.max <= 16
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12"                shows points=11..12, y<=5
      sets  ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game: 13+"                          shows points>=13, y<=5 | y is C | y is D
  3y  "Invitational: 6+ {y}, 11-12"        shows y>=6, points=11..12
      sets  ask=invite(y)
  4y  "Game: 6+ {y}, 13+"                  shows y>=6, points>=13
      when  y is H | y is S
# Above a weak notrump opener's 1NT is 15-17 (rebids.bid): the counts
# are against his range, as after the uncontested 1NT rebid.
after 1x (1z) 1y (P) 1N (P) | 1x (P) 1y (1z) 1N (P) when z is not x, z is not y, y is not x, partner.hcp.min >= 14, partner.hcp.max >= 17
  2N  "Invitational"             shows nt_rebid_invite, y<=5
      sets  ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game"                               shows nt_rebid_game, y<=5 | y is C | y is D
  3y  "Invitational: 6+ {y}"               shows y>=6, nt_rebid_invite
      sets  ask=invite(y)
  4y  "Game: 6+ {y}"                       shows y>=6, nt_rebid_game
      when  y is H | y is S

# ── Responder after a two-level free bid and opener's rebid ──────────
# Where the free bid is forcing (the 21GF cards) opener has to rebid and
# responder may hold anything from 8 up; where it is not, 8-12. Game
# with 13+, an invitation with 11-12, a pass with a minimum
# (2026-09-25: the forcing auctions died in opener's rebid).
# Opener named a major:
after 1x (1y) 2z (P) 2M (P) | 1x (1y) 2z (P) 3M (P) | 1x (2y) 2z (P) 2M (P) | 1x (2y) 2z (P) 3M (P) | 1x (2y) 3z (P) 3M (P) when y is not x, z is not x, z is not y, M is not x, M is not y, M is not z
  4M  "Game: four {M}, 13+"                shows M>=4, points>=13
  cheapest(M) "Raise: four {M}, 11-12"     shows M>=4, points=11..12
      sets  ask=invite(M)
  3N  "Game: 13+, {y} stopped"             shows points>=13, stop(y), M<=3
  cheapest(x) "Preference: 11-12"          shows x>=3, points=11..12, M<=3
      sets  ask=invite(x)
      priority -1
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 13+, no stopper, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows points>=13
      when  cheapest_rank(y) <= 18      # below 3NT
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -2
  P   "Minimum: no game"                   shows points<=10
      priority -5
  cheapest(x) "Preference: two or more {x}"   shows x>=2
      priority -6
# Opener rebid his own suit or raised mine:
after 1x (1y) 2z (P) 2x (P) | 1x (1y) 2z (P) 3x (P) | 1x (2y) 2z (P) 3x (P) | 1x (2y) 3z (P) 3x (P) when y is not x, z is not x, z is not y
  4x  "Game: 3+ {x}, 13+"                  shows x>=3, points>=13
      when  x is H | x is S
  3N  "Game: 13+, {y} stopped"             shows points>=13, stop(y)
  cheapest(x) "Invitational raise: 3+ {x}, 11-12"   shows x>=3, points=11..12
      sets  ask=invite(x)
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 13+, no stopper, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows points>=13
      when  cheapest_rank(y) <= 18      # below 3NT
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -2
after 1x (1y) 2z (P) 3z (P) | 1x (2y) 2z (P) 3z (P) when y is not x, z is not x, z is not y
  4z  "Game in the fit: 13+"               shows points>=13
      when  z is H | z is S
  3N  "Game: 13+, {y} stopped"             shows points>=13, stop(y)
      when  z is C | z is D
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 13+, no stopper, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows points>=13
      when  z is C | z is D, cheapest_rank(y) <= 18
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -2
# Opener raised a three-level minor to four: no room for a cue bid or
# 3NT (2026-09-25: the cue bid landed at 4 of their suit).
after 1x (2y) 3z (P) 4z (P) when y is not x, z is not x, z is not y, z is C | z is D
  5{z}  "Game in the minor: 13+"           shows points>=13
  P     "No game"                          shows points<=12
        priority -5

# ── We redoubled, they ran, opener rebid his suit ────────────────────
# The redouble showed 10+, so the hand is ours: responder does not treat
# opener's rebid as a sign-off (2026-09-26: 10-13 counts passed 2m and
# 2M with game on). Game with 12+, an invitation with 10-11.
after 1x (X) XX (1y) 2x (P) | 1x (X) XX (2y) 2x (P) | 1x (X) XX (1y) 3x (P) | 1x (X) XX (2y) 3x (P) when y is not x
  4{x} "Game: 12+ with a doubleton or better"   shows x>=2, hcp>=12
       when  x is H | x is S
  3N   "Game: 12+ with a stopper in {y}"        shows hcp>=12, stop(y)
       when  x is C | x is D | x<=1
  5{x} "Game in the minor: 13+"                 shows x>=2, hcp>=13
       when  x is C | x is D
       priority -1
  3{x} "Invitational: 10-11 with a doubleton"   shows x>=2, hcp=10..11
       when  partner.last=2{x}
       sets  ask=invite(x)
  P    "Minimum for the redouble: no game"
       priority -5

# ── Catch-all after partner's notrump rebid (Rick, 2026-09-27) ───────
# A notrump rebid is a ladder bid: partner has put a range on a balanced
# hand, so I am captain and bid game with 25 total points between us,
# counting partner at his minimum; opposite 1NT, invite when only his
# maximum reaches it. Below the specific rules (ticket b6: 1C X 1D P
# 2NT P, where 7 passed 18-19).
#
# Not in notrump when partner's shown length and mine make eight cards in
# a major (2026-09-28, NT_Ladder 426: 2C P 2S P 2NT P, where 2NT showed
# two spades and six-card spades bid 3NT): game, or an invitation, in
# the major instead.
when partner.last=1N | partner.last=2N, me.has_bid | style is not bba, partner.balanced, !they.bid | lho.last=P, we.trump is none, !asked
  3N  "Game in notrump"
      shows we.points.min >= 25, we.fit(S).min <= 7, we.fit(H).min <= 7
      priority -8
  2N  "Invitational"
      shows we.points.max >= 25, we.fit(S).min <= 7, we.fit(H).min <= 7
      when  partner.last=1N
      priority -8
  4S  "Game in the spade fit"
      shows we.points.min >= 25, we.fit(S).min >= 8
      priority -8
  4H  "Game in the heart fit"
      shows we.points.min >= 25, we.fit(H).min >= 8
      priority -8
  3S  "Invitation in the spade fit"
      shows we.points.max >= 25, we.fit(S).min >= 8
      when  partner.last=1N
      sets  ask=invite(S)
      priority -8
  3H  "Invitation in the heart fit"
      shows we.points.max >= 25, we.fit(H).min >= 8
      when  partner.last=1N
      sets  ask=invite(H)
      priority -8
  P   "No game"
      shows we.points.max <= 26
      priority -9
  # Slam over partner's notrump (2026-09-30: 2C 2D 2NT 3NT with 33 between
  # us, random deals): over-3nt.bid's calibrated HCP numbers, 6NT with 34
  # on partner's floor, a quantitative 4NT with 32-33.
  6N  "Slam in notrump"
      shows hcp + partner.hcp.min >= 34, we.fit(S).min <= 7, we.fit(H).min <= 7
      priority -8
  4N  "Quantitative: invites 6NT"
      when  quant_4nt   # slam.quantitative_4nt.play (slam-entry.bid)
      shows hcp + partner.hcp.min >= 32, hcp + partner.hcp.max <= 35, we.fit(S).min <= 7, we.fit(H).min <= 7
      sets  ask=quant
      priority -8

# Opener's strong double after 1x (X) 1z (1y): describe, cheapest first
# (ticket b6). Not after a support double (support-doubles.bid).
after 1x (X) 1z (1y) X (P) when z is not x, y is not x, y is not z, !asked support
  cheapest(N) "A stopper in {y}"   shows stop(y), z<=5
  cheapest(z) "Five or more {z}"           shows z>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(x) "Three or more of partner's {x}"          shows x>=3
  cheapest(z) "Rebids {z}"          priority -5

# responder-rebids (`responder-rebids.bid`): notes

Responder's second call after a one-level suit opening, a response and
opener's rebid (Standard American, BBA's Basic-Bridge card). Also:
responder's third call after a 2/1 and after responder's own 1NT. Cases:
`responder-rebids.test`.

## Guidance (Rick, 2026-09-22)

- **Responder invites with 2NT, or with a jump in his own suit, which
  promises six.**
- **A new suit by responder after opener's 1NT is not forcing, unless it is
  a responder's reverse** (game forcing). With or without New Minor
  Forcing; with NMF on, two of the other minor is NMF instead
  (`new-minor-forcing.bid`, a convention of its own).

## How the rest was set

From BBA's meanings and the corpus: opposite a minimum rebid, weak is up to
10, invitational 11-12, game 13+; opposite opener's jumps (16-18) game at
9+, opposite 2NT (18-19) game at 7+. Invitations ask a question, so
opener's existing answers apply: 2NT asks `nt_invite` (accept with a
maximum), a jump in a major asks `invite(M)` (accept in the fit).

Choices from BBA: a weak six-card minor passes 1NT (a weak major rebids
it); preference to opener's major with two cards when opener's second suit
is no longer (false preference), but between minors pass with more of
opener's second suit; a weak hand raises opener's second suit at the two
level up to 10; after a jump rebid in a minor 3NT needs no shortness;
after a 2/1, support means game at 11+ (a 2/1 is already 11+).

## Answering a reverse (2026-09-22)

Opener's reverse is 17+ and forcing for one round, and responder had no
rules for it: he passed, which broke the force. He now bids game with a
maximum for his 1NT response, raises the second suit with four, and
otherwise gives a preference to opener's first suit.

The context is `after 1x (P) 1N (P) 2y (P) when y is not x, we.forcing =
round`. **The `we.forcing` test is what tells a reverse from an ordinary
second suit**: 1♠-1NT-2♥ is not a reverse and responder may pass it,
while 1♦-1NT-2♥ is. Without that condition the rules fired on every
second suit and bid over hands that should pass, at a cost of about a
dozen calls in the Basic_* scenarios.

## Signing off, and the two-over-one after a minor (2026-09-23)

### Responder's weak calls are a question now

Every weak second call here — 1NT over opener's new suit, a preference,
a weak rebid of responder's own suit, a raise of opener's second suit,
a weak new suit over opener's 1NT rebid — now carries
`sets ask=signoff`. It says "play here unless you have real extras", and
opener's answer is written once in rebids.bid (`when asked signoff`)
instead of a dozen eight-call `after` patterns. Every invitational call
sets `ask=invite(x)` or `ask=nt_invite` for the same reason; two of them
(the invitational raise and the invitational preference after opener's
second suit) were not setting any ask, so opener had nothing to answer
with and passed a live auction.

### The two-over-one block was only written for major openings

`after 1M (P) 2x (P) 2z (P)` left 1♦-2♣-2♥ and its relatives with no
rule at all. The rules that do not name a major are now written for any
opening suit `y`, with `y<=2 | y is C | y is D` where "no fit" was meant
(after a minor opening, notrump is the game to look for anyway), and the
raise to game in opener's major stays in a `1M` block of its own.

**The measure was wrong too.** A two-over-one is bid on suit points —
`KJ74.Q95.9.KJ762` is a ten-count at notrump and bids 2♣ — so the
follow-ups that choose a suit now use `suit_points`, and the raise to
game uses support points `tp(M)`. With `points>=11` those hands failed
every rule and passed. Added at the same time: a pass for a minimum
two-over-one when opener rebids his own suit, 3NT over opener's 2NT or
jump rebid, and a raise to three when responder is a maximum for his
1NT response and opener rebids his suit.
